checks.name: small-shop responses and query counts stay unchanged when another shop grows
actual Prisma plans avoid scanning the large shop for small-shop orders/products
numbered history counts only the selected shop
overlapping product slugs resolve independently for each public shop
membership in both shops does not allow mixing resource IDs
composite tenant FK rejects cross-shop category assignment
foreign memberships and invalid tenant contexts fail closed
empty tenant returns empty history and zero count
large and small tenant histories execute concurrently on shared database workers
small-shop tail latency stays within declared local mixed-load budgets
tenant reads and writes remain isolated during simultaneous cross-shop attempts
catalog first and filtered pages use measured tenant indexes
all 20000 products traverse bounded pages without gaps or duplicate identities
category timestamp and sort ties traverse deterministically
public menu independently pages product and category facets without truncation
deep catalog cursors and foreign/changed-filter cursors stay bounded and scoped
live membership removal stops subsequent reads
